name: Ne Davajte Forchanovcu R*boty
source:
If a year ago someone told me — an ordinary anon from 4chan — that I’d be wandering through yellow hallways from internet legends and calling it a j*b, I would have laughed in their face. I would’ve sooner believed that the earth was actually flat.'

Now I’ve got a badge, a workspace… and the probability of dying from an escaped experiment.
